subject: Error when compiling knitr with texmaker on Mac

messages.author: f462c8a407ee046c
messages.subject: Error when compiling knitr with texmaker on Mac
parts:
Dear knitr-Users and knitr-Devels,

I am using the texmaker editor version 4.0.4 and R 3.0.1. knitr is version 1,4.1. I use a very simple code example:

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{amsmath, amssymb}
\usepackage{ctable}
\usepackage{rotating}
%\usepackage{booktabs}
\begin{document}
<<message = FALSE, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'>>=
plot(rnorm(100), rnorm(100))
@
\end{document}

My user command in texmaker for knitr is: Rscript -e “library(knitr); knit(‘%.Rnw’)”. When I compile it in texmaker I get a yet unexplainable error: "unexpected input in "�" Execution halted". I also compiled the code example on the R command line and on my terminal - in both cases the file is compiled. First thought was: its the encoding. But I use UTF-8 for the texmaker editor and I include the command \usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}. 

Where should I look for the error? What could it be?


Best

Simon
